cases.title: A passing command does not keep an old finding current
cases.notes: The unrelated widget finding stays current. A pass does not erase every earlier finding; it does retire this one because the cited source changed and the command passed.

cases.title: A later failure after a pass, task status left open
cases.notes: Whether a Done task should become Active again is an unresolved product contract. The run records task status and does not score it.

cases.title: A retraction in one task must not retire another task

atoms.justification: The retract note was submitted in the beta session. It must not supersede the alpha claim.

cases.title: A retracted claim can be stated again

atoms.justification: The listing still supports the increment, and the earlier copy was retracted before this restatement.

cases.title: A wall-clock correction must survive replay
cases.notes: Handoff stamps extracted claims at max(timestamp)+1000ms. The user retract uses wall-clock time. Replay order is not the client order.

atoms.justification: The client retracted the claim after it was admitted. Replay must not apply that retract before the claim exists.

cases.title: Might remains a hypothesis

atoms.justification: The note says the budget might increment. The listing does not turn that into a settled fact by itself, and the uncertainty should be kept.

cases.title: Probably is also uncertainty

atoms.justification: Probably is weaker than an established fact. Dropping it or storing it as reality both miss the uncertainty.

cases.title: Renderer trim order is not exposed
cases.notes: context_now has no token-budget parameter, so trim order cannot be forced through the public protocol.

cases.title: Direct agent claim bypasses the evidence gate
cases.notes: agent_claim validates origin and kind and does not run evidence_relation. Admission is not verification. The product contract for this route is unresolved.

atoms.justification: No tool output mentions a pool. Recording the route is required; calling the claim verified is not.

cases.title: Shell hooks do not capture stdout
cases.notes: The installed shell hook sends command, cwd, and exit code. It cannot supply the output a semantic checker would need. This is a capture limit, not a verifier defect.

cases.title: Regex atom recall is not factuality
cases.notes: A required-atom style regex matches a packet that also states a contradiction. The atomic judge flags the contradiction.
